published_statement: General theorem (EGJ 1965, as restated, Kontou-Sanders 2003.01815 Thm 3.2, verbatim via prior-stage read): 'Let A in A(O) be a self-adjoint local operator of a QFT such that <psi|A psi> >= 0 for all psi in the domain of A. Suppose <Omega|A Omega> = 0. Then A == 0.'; Fewster math-ph/0501073 p.2: 'the energy density in any Wightman field theory necessarily admits negative expectation values (unless it is trivial).' Explicit squeezed form (KF 1993 Eq.(3.22), in the shape the tree transcribes at fluctuation.py:259 and re-derived here as A1): for one plane-wave mode of a free massless scalar in a box of volume V, normal ordered with respect to the Minkowski vacuum, in the squeezed vacuum S(r e^{i theta})|0>, <:T00:> = 2K sinh r [sinh r + cosh r cos(2(k.x - omega t) + theta)], K = hbar omega/(2V); negative wherever cos(...) < -tanh r.
published_hypotheses: P1 free field (massless scalar in KF; the EM plane-wave mode has the same form because :E^2: = :B^2: for one plane-wave mode) -- KF K2
P2 flat (Minkowski) background -- KF K1 ('restricted to a flat spacetime background', Sec. V)
P3 energy density = EXPECTATION VALUE of T00 normal ordered with respect to the Minkowski vacuum (vacuum = zero of energy; EGJ H3 'vanishing vacuum expectation value'; KF K3)
P4 pointwise value exists (Hadamard state; a finite-mode Bogoliubov transform of the vacuum is one) -- EGJ-restatement H6
P5 single mode (box normalisation, volume V) for the explicit form; EGJ itself is state-generic and asserts only that SOME state gives a negative expectation
P6 EGJ delivers NONPOSITIVITY only; pointwise unboundedness needs an extra scaling hypothesis (prior-stage audit epstein-glaser-jaffe-1965.json H5) -- not used by this key
hypothesis_drift: WEAKENED -- candidates.py:94-95 'a state in which the energy density at a spacetime point is genuinely negative': the source result is the EXPECTATION VALUE of the Minkowski-vacuum-normal-ordered T00 (P3). The squeezed vacuum is not an eigenstate of T00(x): re-derived here (C1, exact Fock at r = 0.5, 0.8, 1.0) <:T00^2:> = 3 <:T00:>^2 identically, i.e. relative fluctuation Delta' = 2 at every point where rho != 0, on both sides of zero -- the tree's own fluctuation.py:90-91 already records this. 'Genuinely negative' holds in expectation, not as a sharp local value.

DROPPED -- candidates.py:94-97 (KIND 'A real rho < 0') omits that the negativity is a minority of each cycle and is over-compensated within the same wave: the negative phase fraction is arccos(tanh r)/pi (0.468 at r = 0.1, 0.224 at r = 1, 0.032 at r = 3; B5), the cycle average is +2K sinh^2 r > 0 (B4), and the positive/negative integral ratio per cycle is 1.37 (r = 0.1), 22.5 (r = 1), 9533 (r = 3) (B5). The total energy of the state is positive (hbar omega sinh^2 r per mode).

DROPPED -- candidates.py:97: the single-mode negative dip SATURATES. min <:T00:> = -K(1 - e^{-2r}) > -hbar omega/(2V) for every r (B1, B3): squeezing never drives the local expectation below minus that mode's own zero-point energy density, and further squeezing adds only positive energy. This does not touch KIND (negative for every r > 0, B2); it bears on MAGNITUDE, which the tree fails independently (candidates.py:451-452).

ADDED (unstated) -- candidates.py:99 'Kill the pump and it is gone at c. Nothing to remove.' holds under hypotheses the tree does not name: (i) free massless propagation in vacuum -- the negative regions move rigidly at c because <:T00:> depends on k.x - omega t only with omega = |k| (D1); with any mass or dispersion the group velocity is < c (D2 control), so inside the nonlinear crystal or a fibre the clearing is at the group velocity c/n_g, not c; (ii) single-pass generation -- for a cavity-enhanced source (an OPO, the kind used in gravitational-wave squeezers) the field left when the pump stops decays over the cavity storage time, a device-specific figure NOT computed here; (iii) 'gone' means DEPARTS at c together with its positive over-compensation (drift 2), not annihilated. This is the canonical hypothesis 'deadline pass assumes the negative region clears at c when the pump stops'.

WEAKENED (status word in rests_on, outside the owner) -- ledger.py:1553 / LEDGER.md:60 file S3 as MEASURED and achievable.py:32 says 'MEASURED (LIGO uses it)'. What experiments measure is a sub-shot-noise quadrature variance; for a single plane-wave mode <:T00:> = <:E^2:> is proportional to (V_phi - V_vac), so a measured sub-shot-noise variance IS a negative normal-ordered energy density at that phase within the single-mode plane-wave idealisation (E1). A direct measurement of T00 < 0 was not read here; a meta-analysis testing a quantum inequality against squeezed-light data exists (arXiv:1806.01269, NAMED-NOT-READ). Recorded, not repaired.

rederivation.outcome: 21/21 PASS, exit 0 (~30 s; sympy + numpy; imports nothing from research/). A1 (sympy): from <aa> = -e^{i theta} sinh r cosh r, <a^dag a> = sinh^2 r, a single plane-wave mode of the free massless scalar gives <:T00:> = 2K sinh r (sinh r + cosh r cos(2chi + theta)), K = omega/(2V) -- the KF (3.22) shape the tree transcribes. A2: independent control, the squeeze operator built numerically in a 120-level Fock space reproduces both moments (residual <= 8.8e-9, truncation). B1-B3 (sympy): minimum -K(1 - e^{-2r}), negative for every r > 0, saturating at -K = -hbar omega/(2V) as r -> oo. B4: cycle average +2K sinh^2 r. B5 (numeric, 4e5 phases): negative phase fraction arccos(tanh r)/pi, positive/negative ratio 1.37 to 9533 for r = 0.1 to 3. C1 (exact Fock, 160 levels): <:T00:> matches the closed form and <:T00^2:>/rho^2 = 3.000000 at three (r, theta, chi) including a negative-rho point -- Delta' = 2. D1 (sympy): the pattern is invariant under (t, x) -> (t + D, x + D): it moves rigidly at c; D2 control: any mass gives group velocity < c. E1: dB -> min rho/K = 10^{-dB/10} - 1 = -(1 - e^{-2r}).

lacked_data: The result is a property of a free-field quantum state (EGJ: a theorem from axioms; KF (3.22): an exact single-mode computation), with no numerical input -- so there is no datum the authors could have lacked that would move the SIGN. Evidence: B2 shows negativity for every r > 0, and the only empirical quantity that enters (the squeezing level) moves the dip between 0 and its floor -hbar omega/(2V), never across zero (E1). What arrived later is confirmatory or scoping, not refuting: (a) laboratory squeezing to ~15 dB (NAMED-NOT-READ) -- by E1 a sub-shot-noise quadrature variance is the same object as a negative normal-ordered <:E^2:> in the single-mode plane-wave idealisation, so measurements support the kind claim; (b) quantum-interest results (Ford-Roman 1999 NAMED-NOT-READ; Fewster-Teo 2000 READ by a prior stage) -- these scope 'nothing to remove', and the single-mode computation here (B4-B5) shows the scoping explicitly; (c) the fluctuation result (KF 1993; the tree's own fluctuation.py) -- the negativity is an expectation with Delta' = 2. The one place M's hypothesis has real purchase is not a moved datum but an unsettled premise: whether the vacuum-subtracted EXPECTATION value is what gravitates at a point when fluctuations are of order unity (semiclassical validity). That is not decided by anything read here; it does not flip KIND = True as the tree defines KIND (a real T00 expectation < 0), but it limits what 'genuinely negative' licenses as a gravitational source.
grade_evidence: The core statement STANDS as mathematics: a single-mode squeezed vacuum of a free massless field has a negative Minkowski-vacuum-normal-ordered energy-density expectation on part of every cycle, for every r > 0 -- re-derived symbolically (A1, B1-B2) with an independent Fock-space control (A2, C1), consistent with EGJ nonpositivity (prior-stage restatement read) and the KF (3.22) shape the tree already carries (fluctuation.py:259). The tree's USE is broader than the result on four named points, none of which flips a flag in rests_on (kind = True and deadline = True both survive on the board's class): (1) 'genuinely negative at a point' is an expectation value with Delta' = 2 (C1; fluctuation.py:90-91); (2) the negativity is a minority phase, over-compensated in the same wave (B4-B5); (3) the dip saturates at -hbar omega/(2V) per mode (B3); (4) 'gone at c' needs free massless vacuum propagation and single-pass generation (D1-D2) -- in a medium it clears at the group velocity, and a cavity source at its storage time. The S3 status word MEASURED (ledger.py:1553) is supportable only through the single-mode plane-wave identification of sub-shot-noise variance with <:E^2:> < 0 (E1). Nothing here is WRONG. Limitation of this audit, stated: the source pages were not re-opened this stage (alphaXiv quota exhausted, egress blocked); the reads relied on are prior DOCKET 67 stages' reads banked on disk, and the explicit formula is COMPUTED here rather than quoted.
what_would_change_the_grade: To STANDS: the tree names the four hypotheses at candidates.py:92-99 (expectation value with Delta' = 2; positive cycle average / same-wave over-compensation; single-mode floor -hbar omega/(2V); free-space single-pass propagation for 'gone at c') -- then statement and use coincide. To WRONG: an exact computation showing <:T00:> >= 0 everywhere in a squeezed vacuum of a free field (A1/A2/C1 contradict this), or a demonstration that the deadline fails under the stated hypotheses (D1 contradicts this). To OPEN: none for the KIND half, which is computed; if a reader requires the KF (3.22) text verbatim, re-open gr-qc/9304008 p.(3.22) through alphaXiv when the quota resets and compare to A1. To DATA-DEPENDENT: none -- no datum enters the sign.
